newsitem.title: USA: Metzler Group to pursue acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Metzler Group to pursue acquisitions.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc, a provider of consulting services to electric utilities and energy-related businesses, said on Thursday it plans to pursue strategic acquisitions to supplement its growth.
The company, which began trading publicly October 4, also said it plans to beef up its professional staff.

"Our professional staff is expected to grow to approximately 50 by the end of this year from 35 at the end of 1995," said chairman Robert Mahler in a statement. "During 1997, we plan to increase our key personnel to approximately 80 individuals."
Metzler Group reported pro forma third-quarter earnings of $0.10 per share, up from $0.05 per share a year ago. Revenues rose to $5.6 million from $3.7 million.
